items.title: X adds thumbnail and caption options.
items.para: Creators can pick a thumbnail frame, style captions and convert horizontal clips to vertical in one tap.
items.tip: Reuse broadcast-style highlights as vertical clips and lead with the celebration frame.

items.title: Meta's Edits app now runs on iPad.
items.para: The update adds trim on import, 1,600 stickers and a copyright check on iOS, with five checks a day.
items.tip: Run a copyright check before posting match footage and licensed music.

items.title: Threads tests upvoted Q&A in live chats.
items.para: Hosts collect questions and the chat votes on which ones get answered, in a limited test.
items.tip: Try a player or coach Q&A during a match-day live chat once it reaches your account.

items.title: TikTok's music report: 94% of chart entries went viral first.
items.para: A TikTok-commissioned Luminate study says 94% of 2025 Billboard Global 200 entries had a viral TikTok moment before charting.
items.tip: Treat it as TikTok's own claim. Test sound-led clips, with music rights cleared.

items.title: Twitch brings back Hosting.
items.para: Offline streamers will be able to feature another live channel with shared chat, rolling out later this year.
items.tip: If you stream, cross-promote partner or player channels when you are offline.
